text:
Help centre › Cards › Card activation
A newly issued card stays inactive until it is switched on. Open the Cards tab, select the new card and choose Activate, then enter the six-digit code printed on the carrier letter. Activation completes within a few seconds, after which the card is ready for chip and online use.

Help centre › Cash › ATM support
The card can be used at cash machines that display the network logo printed on the front of the card. The map in the Cards tab lists nearby machines run by partner networks, with opening hours for machines located inside shops or stations.

Help centre › Wallets › Apple Pay or Google Pay
The card can be added to a handset wallet from the card screen: select the card, choose Add to wallet and follow the prompts from the wallet provider. Purchases are then made by holding the handset near the terminal and confirming with face or fingerprint recognition.

Help centre › Security › Change PIN
The PIN can be changed at any cash machine that offers PIN services: insert the card, choose PIN services, then enter the current PIN followed by the new one twice. The new PIN applies to chip payments and cash machines from the next use of the card.

Help centre › Eligibility › Supported countries
Accounts are available to residents of the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, Switzerland, Australia and the United States. Residents of further countries can join a waiting list in the app. The list of supported countries is revised each quarter.

Help centre › Eligibility › Age requirement
The main account is open to customers aged 18 and over. Teenagers aged 13 to 17 can hold a linked junior account managed by a parent or guardian, with spending limits set by the adult holder.

Help centre › Top-ups › Automatic top-up
Automatic top-up adds a chosen amount from a linked card whenever the balance falls below a threshold set by the customer. The feature is switched on under Account › Top-up rules, where both the threshold and the amount can be edited at any stage.

Help centre › Cards › Get virtual card
A virtual card is created instantly in the Cards tab by choosing Add card › Virtual. It has its own number, expiry and security code, and can be frozen or deleted separately from the plastic card. Virtual cards are intended for online purchases.

Help centre › Identity checks › How to verify my identity
Identity checks are completed in the app with a photo of a passport, national identity card or driving licence, followed by a short selfie video. Most checks finish within ten minutes, and progress is shown under Profile › Identity.

Help centre › Account › Close account
An account can be closed from Profile › Close account once the remaining balance has been moved out. Statements from the past six years remain downloadable after closure.

Help centre › Profile › Edit personal details
Name, home address and contact number are changed under Profile › Edit personal details. A change of legal name needs a supporting document, such as a marriage certificate or deed poll, uploaded in the same screen.

Help centre › Currencies › Exchange rate
The exchange rate shown in the app follows the interbank market rate and refreshes every few seconds during market hours. The rate for a conversion is fixed at the moment the conversion is confirmed.

Help centre › Security › Lost or stolen phone
If the handset with the banking app goes missing, log in from a computer and choose Security › Sign out all sessions. Sessions on the missing handset end at once, and a new handset can be registered after a fresh identity check.

Help centre › Cards › Visa or Mastercard
Cards issued in Europe run on the Mastercard network; cards issued in the United States and Australia run on Visa. The network is printed on the front of the card and shown in Card details. Both networks are accepted by the same merchants in almost all regions.

Help centre › Transfers › Transfer timing
Transfers between customers of the bank arrive instantly. Domestic bank transfers usually arrive within two hours on working days, and international SWIFT transfers take one to five working days depending on the intermediary banks.

Assistant help › Routing number
The assistant can read out the nine-digit routing number of a linked account. The same number appears in the account details section of the bank's website.

Assistant help › Credit limit
For a linked card, the assistant reports the current credit limit and the remaining available credit. Limits are set by the issuer; the assistant reads the figure from the most recent statement sync.

Assistant help › Redeem rewards
Points earned on a linked card can be redeemed for statement credits or airline miles through the issuer's portal. The assistant opens the portal and lists the redemption options available.

Assistant help › Plug type
The assistant names the socket standard and mains voltage for a destination country, for example Type G at 230 V in the United Kingdom and Type A or B at 120 V in the United States, and says whether an adapter is needed.

Assistant help › Lost luggage
For a delayed or missing bag, the assistant gives the airline's baggage desk hours and a link to the online claim form. A property irregularity report filed at the airport speeds up tracing.

Assistant help › Tire pressure
With a connected vehicle, the assistant reads each tire's pressure in psi and compares it with the value on the door-jamb placard. Readings are most accurate on cold tires, before driving more than a mile.

Assistant help › Update playlist
Songs can be added to or removed from a saved playlist by naming the song and the playlist. Changes sync to the linked streaming account within a minute.

Assistant help › Ingredient substitution
The assistant suggests common swaps, such as plain yogurt for sour cream or applesauce for oil in baking, along with the quantity to use. Substitutions made for allergy reasons are marked with a caution symbol.

Assistant help › Food shelf life
The assistant gives typical storage durations, for example three to five days for cooked rice in the fridge or up to a year for hard cheese in the freezer. Figures follow published food-safety guidance.

Assistant help › Set a timer
Timers run on the speaker or phone and can be named, for example a pasta timer. Several timers can run at once, and each announces its name when it finishes.

Assistant help › Time-off balance
For employers connected to the HR system, the assistant reports remaining vacation days and sick-leave hours for the current year, as recorded in the latest payroll run.

Assistant help › W-2 form
The assistant states when the employer posts the W-2 form in the payroll portal, usually by the end of January, and can open the portal page where the PDF is downloaded for filing.

Assistant settings › Change language
The spoken and display language of the assistant can be switched to any of 24 supported languages. After switching, wake-word detection may ask for a short retraining sample.

Assistant settings › Whisper mode
In whisper mode the assistant answers quietly when spoken to in a whisper, which suits late hours. The mode is switched on in the device settings and stays active until it is switched off.

Assistant help › Tell a joke
On request the assistant will tell a joke from a curated collection of family-friendly one-liners and puns. Repeated requests draw from the collection without repeats until it is exhausted.

Voice assistant guide › Set alarm
An alarm can be set for a specific clock hour or relative to the present moment, and can repeat on chosen weekdays. Each alarm has a label and a sound, both editable from the companion screen.

Voice assistant guide › Play podcast
The assistant can play podcast episodes from the linked provider by show name or episode number, and resumes from the last position heard on any linked speaker.

Voice assistant guide › Order takeaway
With a linked delivery service, the assistant can reorder a previous takeaway meal or read out the menu of a saved restaurant before placing the new order. Payment uses the card stored with the service.

Voice assistant guide › Dim lights
Connected bulbs can be dimmed by percentage or by named scene, per room or across the whole house. Dimming below 10 percent is supported only by bulbs with a low-level driver.

Voice assistant guide › Book a taxi
The assistant can book a taxi through the linked ride provider, confirming the pickup point and the estimated fare before sending the booking. Driver arrival updates are read out on request.

Voice assistant guide › Time zone conversion
The assistant converts a clock reading between cities, for example 9:00 in Chicago to the equivalent hour in Singapore, and accounts for daylight-saving changes on the given day.

Voice assistant guide › Mute audio
Mute audio silences the speaker output while keeping the microphone active, so the wake word still works. Saying the wake word followed by unmute restores the previous level.

Voice assistant guide › Movie recommendation
The assistant can suggest films by genre, actor or decade, drawing on the watch history of the linked streaming profile, and gives showtimes at nearby cinemas on request.

Voice assistant guide › Make coffee
A connected coffee machine can brew a preset drink by voice, such as a single espresso or a large filter cup. The machine needs water and beans loaded, and the assistant reports when brewing starts.

Voice assistant guide › Remove from list
Items can be deleted from a named shopping or to-do list by saying the item and the list name. Deleted items stay in a recently-deleted section for thirty days.
